description.en: Opens the sound resource for a technique/skill by name and outcome variant (e.g. success/failure), returning a handle to play with CMND_SND_PLAY.
Name of the technique/skill sound to open.
Outcome variant index (e.g. 0 for the base version).

example.code:
// Open a technique's sound effect
local hSound = CMND_SND_OPEN_WAZA(skill_name, 0);
